description: Payment Guard: enforce your own spend rules before an agent pays. Set rules once per API key (or an account default): max_per_call_usd, daily_budget_usd, period_budget_usd + period_hours, allowed_sellers, allowed_domains, max_calls_per_minute, max_calls_per_hour. Then send each payment intent to POST /v1/payment-guard/authorize: allow returns a short-lived Ed25519-signed clearance (not a payment signature) and reserves the amount against your budgets atomically; block returns HTTP 403 with reasons and nothing is reserved. POST /v1/payment-guard/proxy does the same check and, on allow, forwards your client-signed PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (or X-PAYMENT) to the seller once per event_id. Non-custodial: Screwtape.ai never holds funds and never accepts private keys, seeds or mnemonics. Requires a Bearer API key. authorize and proxy use one shared free-tier or prepaid call each ($0.005 equivalent); rules endpoints are free. Same event_id + body replays the decision without billing again. Over MCP, send the Bearer API key as the Authorization header of the MCP connection. Set rules first with PUT https://screwtape.ai/v1/payment-guard/rules. A block is a normal result (isError false, decision "block").

amount_usd.description: Amount the agent wants to pay.

event_id.description: Your id for this payment. Reusing it with the same body replays the decision.

payee.description: Payee address or id, checked against allowed_sellers.

payment_required.description: Optional: the seller's 402 payload, used to read the payee.

seller_url.description: Public https URL of the paid resource. Required for proxy.

name: payment_guard_authorize

clearance.description: Ed25519-signed clearance on allow. Not a payment signature.
